svg.text: Each side drawn as seen from that side, forward (nose tip) up — the panels are mirror images. Dashed outlines are parts on the OTHER side of the board.
Tall side faces 270° (camera port); low side faces 90° (the web, which the board hangs off on two M3 standoffs).
M3 standoffs (low side) take M3 plastic
screws from the web's far face — M3 × 10,
which stops short of the board.
Dashed rings on the low side: the BMP388's
The sensors stand ~1 mm proud on their
pins, header plastic up against the
sensor, clear of the tall side's joints.
